device: A herbarium sheet, on the brand deck
lede: (the khadi stills on the deck's blush ground: the deck's watercolour tulips rising at the right edge to touch the photograph, the sage leaves under the foot, a label ruled in sage, the referent named botanically, and the coral tulip stamp from the box tissue.)
idea: The first pass used the website's line vine and painted dahlia; the brand deck says the florals are watercolour tulips in peach with sage leaves on a blush or sage ground, with the wordmark in sage or white. So this pass is rebuilt on the deck: blush ground (#FFF8F5 sampled from the deck), the tulip cluster keyed out of the deck's own brand-look tile and placed where the deck places it, at the edge, never under the copy; the sage-and-coral wordmark from the deck's logo page in the top bar; the label ruled in sage; and the coral round sticker from the box tissue, carrying the brand flower, as the specimen stamp. The herbarium idea stays because it fits the volume; the dressing is now the brand's.
type: Blush ground; the plate full-bleed at the top; a 1.5px sage rule opens the label; mono eyebrow in dark sage; the name in Velista, ink; rows in Cormorant italic with sage mono keys; the referent leader a dashed sage curve with a haloed italic label; the stamp a 118px coral disc with the flower in white. Foot: name in ink, spec in sage, price in ink, CTA solid sage with white type.
review: Editor's pass 1 on the redo: the tulips sat under the copy at multiply and read as a stain across the seam, the sage wordmark was faint at 30px. Pass 2: tulips moved to the right column at full opacity touching the plate's bottom edge, leaves to the lower left behind the foot, copy column capped at 62% so type never crosses a flower, wordmark at 48px in a slightly darker sage for photographs, leader labels enlarged. Plates unchanged and verified as before; the textured hoop's copy uses the listing's own words.
verdict: specimen 01 leads; specimen 05, the chain, is the one to run at spend.
